title: Colour accents in the new dashboard, and screenshots that show them
description: The ymf screenshots (docs/design/watch-redesign-2026-10/*.png) are monochrome. Find whether the new view dropped the colour accents (green done, amber in progress, red failed/held, dim pending/mechanics) or the capture ran without colour; fix whichever, and re-capture the five screenshots in colour.
acceptance_criteria: colour accents render on a colour terminal (test on the styled output); the five PNGs re-captured in colour; make gate
